title: An optogenetics device with smartphone video capture to introduce neurotechnology and systems neuroscience to high school students.
source_locator: Results, 'Device validation–activating freezing neurons'; Fig 3A-B; S2 Movie (not downloaded)
quote: We found that flies expressing CsChrimson in neurons labeled by this line displayed freezing behavior at a high probability (Fig 3A, 3B and S2 Movie).
mapping_basis: Paper names the SS1540 neurons 'a bilateral pair of descending neurons, called DNp09' (Namiki nomenclature, line cited to Namiki 2018); driver_lines.csv lists SS01540 as AMBIGUOUS (DNp09; DNp71, the latter only via the hemibrain name DNp09), so the Namiki-system usage supports MANC DNp09.
stimulation: 627 nm red LED, single 300 ms pulse, 0.16 mW/mm2 at the fly (2 mm from LED); one stimulation per fly
sensory_condition: tethered to tungsten wire by the notum, no tarsal contact (legs free in air); flies showing grooming/struggling leg movements before stimulation; dark-recovered
other_cell_types: other (unidentified) neurons labelled by SS1540-split-Gal4, proposed by the authors (citing Bidaye 2020) to cause the freezing
coordination_notes: complete interruption of appendage movement during and after the light; leg movement resumes later (Fig 3A schematic)
penetrance: about 62% of retinal-fed SS1540 x CsChrimson flies froze vs about 20% of non-retinal-fed and 0% of wild-type controls (Fig 3B bars, read from figure)
n_flies_note: n = 80 retinal-fed experimental flies; 79 non-retinal-fed; 24 per wild-type x CsChrimson control (Fig 3B)
notes: Freezing scored by eye (a consecutive 120 ms absence of leg motion after the light ended) by an experimenter who was not blinded. The authors say the freezing may come from other SS1540 neurons, not DNp09. They did not see the reported DNp09 increase in locomotion and attribute this to the tethered, no-tarsal-contact preparation. The 'stops' code means the legs stopped moving; the flies were not walking on a substrate. The high-school workshop used the same line and preparation and reported only that freezing was 'easily detected', with no separate data, so it is folded into this record. The paper reports no simulations. SS1540 in the paper = SS01540 (VT023490-p65ADZp; R38F04-ZpGAL4DBD).
